notes: Four fixes to how Crisp reads what you type. Ask for the volume, the brightness or the speed whichever way round you say it — "turn up the volume" and "turn the volume up" both land now, and so do the audio, the sound and the levels, not just the word volume. Asking to reduce sharpness used to plan a render that changed nothing and then tell you it had reduced it; Crisp now says plainly that it cannot soften a picture. Speeding up and slowing down answer the same set of phrasings in both directions. And a password or licence key that lands in a crash report is redacted in every shape it can arrive in.
